Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_donor_decision_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_contract VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_result_dats date;
 temp_drive_id varchar(6) ;
 temp_coll_date date ;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 begin
 --
 -- this SQL guarantees that unit_id itself is unique
 -- throughout the system, independent of the chapter
 -- or the collection date. All other places need
 -- coll_date and chapter_id as part of the primary key
 --
 select donor_decision_code
 into temp_donor_decision_code
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id;
 if temp_donor_decision_code is not null
 then
 show_error('2511');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'N';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 go_item('s_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 show_error('0160');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
/*--- Since the tube check-in program will update the UNITS table, so the result of
 the following query will indicate whether tubes are already checked in for
 this unit. Modified by Nabendu on 02/06/97 to verify the drive ID and
 coll. date if tube has already been checked in ----*/

 begin
 select drive_id,coll_date
 into temp_drive_id,temp_coll_date 
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id ;

 /*--- Tubes has already been checked-in --------*/ 
 :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 
 /*-- Drive ID or Coll. date should not be null if tubes are already
 checked in ---------*/
 if temp_drive_id is null or temp_coll_date is null
 then
 show_error('0085') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.drive_id != temp_drive_id 
 then
 show_error('2504') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date != temp_coll_date 
 then
 show_error('2505') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then /*---- Tubes has not been checked in -------*/
 :GLOBAL.unit_tube_checkin_flag := 'N';
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then /*-- More than one record present with this unit ID --*/
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 go_item('s_unit_id');
 clear_item;
 show_error('0170');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then 
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;


 begin
 select nvl(min(result_dats),:coll_date+1)
 into temp_result_dats
 from unit_test_base
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 if trunc(:coll_date) > trunc(temp_result_dats)
 then
 show_error('0094');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_dd_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_dd_code_desc VARCHAR2(50);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if NVL(length(:s_dd), 0) != 7
 then
 show_error('1210');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 -- HCL C validate_dd_scan_codabar(:s_dd,temp_dd_code,
 --HCL C temp_dd_code_desc);

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 validate_dd_scan_codabar(:s_dd,temp_dd_code,
 temp_dd_code_desc);
 ELSE
 validate_dd_scan_code128(:s_dd,temp_dd_code,temp_dd_code_desc);
 END IF;
 :donor_decision_code := temp_dd_code;
 if temp_dd_code in ('Y','N')
 then
 temp_dd_code_desc := 'Done';
 end if;
 :donor_decision_code_desc := temp_dd_code_desc;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: PERFORM_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :s_dd is null
 then
 :s_dd := 'no_scan';
 end if;
 if :s_dd != '123'
 then
 if :s_dd = 'no_scan'
 then
 :s_dd := '';
 end if;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;


 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 
 /*-- Following is true if bag is checked-in before initial check-in ----*/
 if :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 update units
 set donor_decision_code = :donor_decision_code,
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 drive_id = :drive_id,
 contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 insert into units
 (unit_id, chk_digit , coll_date, chapter_id, insert_dats, drive_id,
 donor_decision_code, contract_id,
 received_date, program_id)
 values
 (:unit_id,substr(:chk_digit,2), :coll_date, :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 sysdate, :drive_id, 
 :donor_decision_code, :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id,
 trunc(sysdate), :banner.prog_name);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;


 --
 -- Interdictions because of bad Cue
 --
 if :donor_decision_code = 'N'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'SELF',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions SELF not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'A'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'AMBI',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions AMBI not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'O'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'NCP',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions NCP not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :donor_decision_code = 'T'
 then
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction (
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'THER',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdictions THER not assigned to unit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;


 begin
 --
 -- it is possible that interdictions were created
 -- from test results at a time when the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
 -- coll_date are going to be null in unit_interdictions.
 -- This is updated the first unit is checked
 -- in from any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units from different chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 update unit_interdictions
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit interdictions');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
 --
 -- it is possible that tests were created in utrs
 -- at a time when the unit was not checked-in at all,
 -- specially for antigens. In such cases, the chapter_id and
 -- coll_date are going to be null in utrs.
 -- This is updated when the first unit is checked
 -- in from any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here as units from different chapters might
 -- actually get the same chapter_id.
 --
 update utrs
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in updating utrs - coll_date/chapter_id is null');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;



 begin
 --
 -- it is possible that transactions were created
 -- in unit_test_base when the unit was not
 -- checked-in at all. In such cases, the chapter_id and
 -- coll_date are going to be null in
 -- unit_test_base. This is updated when the first unit
 -- is checked in from any source. There is an inherent
 -- bug here in case of collision between unit_ids from
 -- two different chapters.
 --
 update unit_test_base
 set chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 coll_date = :coll_date,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 (chapter_id is null or coll_date is null);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating unit test base');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;
end;
